title: Maintenance outstanding – payment and account verification
summary: Please pay the outstanding maintenance shown against your unit, or send the Society your payment receipts if you think the figure is wrong.
body: The unit-wise statement on this website reproduces the closing balances recorded in the Society’s Sundry Debtors – Group Summary for 1 April 2018 to 30 September 2026. Member balances and Builder Pending Maintenance (BPM) are shown separately. No interest has been added to these balances.

Payment within 7 days: members are requested to pay the outstanding amount shown against their unit within 7 days of receiving this notice. If it remains unpaid, the Society may consider levying interest on overdue charges at the rate permitted by the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act, Rules, the Society’s bye-laws and General Body resolutions. Any such interest will be calculated separately.

Discrepancies: if you believe the amount shown against your unit is incorrect, submit a written representation with copies of all relevant maintenance payment receipts to the Society office within 7 days. The Society will verify them against its records and correct the account where the discrepancy is established. Please keep your original receipts.
The statement is a closing-balance statement, not a member-wise transaction ledger. It does not calculate historical interest or allocate payments to specific periods.
